text:
Marta G: Heads-up: I'm pulling together the relnotes for the docs site release (0.9.1). Need concise bullets for feature highlights, a 2-line migration note for the SDK change, verified Python + JS snippets, and a short public-safe known-issue blurb for embeddings.
Ethan R: I can author the SDK examples. Do we prefer idiomatic async JS or sync-style examples?
Marta G: Async JS + simple sync-ish Python. Keep both minimal (3-4 lines). Call out the new optional param `response_format` and the `structured_json` option.
Lina S: For the known issue: we observed duplicate vectors in a customer ingestion flow when prefix caching and a short Redis TTL overlapped. We should not expose internal incident refs. Proposed public wording: "Known issue: In rare ingestion workloads using prefix caching with low cache TTLs, duplicate embeddings may appear. Mitigation: increase `prefix_cache_ttl` (recommend ≥300s) or disable prefix caching during ingestion. Contact Redwood Support for assistance."
Arjun K: Also add a small note under behavior changes: canary fallback now prefers cheaper-compatible variants which can slightly affect tail latency. Short line is fine.
Ethan R: JS snippet (draft):```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const res = await client.generate('Summarize the release highlights', { response_format: 'structured_json' })
console.log(res.structured)
```
Ethan R: Python snippet (draft):```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
r = c.generate('Summarize the release highlights', response_format='structured_json')
print(r.structured)
```
Marta G: Migration blurb suggestion: "v2 -> v3: `generate(prompt)` accepts an optional `response_format` string (`raw` or `structured_json`). If you rely on structured fields, validate them after upgrading." Keep it 1-2 lines.
Lina S: Looks good. I'll trim the wording to be public-safe and add the mitigation tip.
DocsBot: PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/redwood/docs/pull/1251 6a7 contains relnotes + snippets (automated).
Arjun K: Can we put the routing note as: "Note: canary fallbacks may prefer cost-compatible variants, possibly increasing median latency in certain configs. See Routing docs to tune policy."
Marta G: Yep, add under "Notable behavior changes". Keep it non-alarming.
Ethan R: Pushed updated snippets to the PR. Left one inline question about import paths for the SDK package name.
Marta G: We'll standardize on `@redwood/inference` across examples.
DocsBot: CI check passed for PR #1251 44d: https://ci.redwood.com/1251/build/7
Arjun K: Quick copy pass done. Two tiny grammar nits pushed as suggestions.
Ethan R: Addressed the nits and updated commit. Ready for final review.
Marta G: Final reviewers: Arjun + Lina. If green, I'll merge and send a short changelog email to community and marketing.
Lina S: I'll prepare an internal CS note with the known-issue text so Support can triage incoming tickets.
Marta G: Thanks all 44b. Action items: Ethan finalize examples (done), Lina prepare public-safe known-issue + internal CS note (in progress), Arjun final QA (done). I'll merge after approvals.
